description: The Course mainly focus on Power system which includes Generation, Transmission and Distribution, the Course also covers AC and DC machines, Switch Gears, Industrial Electrical Systems, Industrial Drives, Industrial electronics and PLC, Electronics and Automation Engineering. Trainees are being equipped with recent technology developments in Industries related to Power sector and Automation. The subjects covered in this Programme are - Switch Gear and Protection, Power Engineering-II, Power Electronics-I, Embedded System, Applied Control System, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Power Electronics-II, Industrial Management, Industrial drives and Traction system, Estimation, Costing and Utilization of Energy, Employability Skill, Power Electronics-I Lab, Embedded System Lab, IoT Lab, Applied Control System Lab, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Lab, Industrial Drives Lab, Project, OJT

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Lab
Estimation, Costing and Utilization of Energy

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant Qualification of NSQF Level 4
eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONCOMPLETED: Advance Certificate Technician Industrial Electrical Level 4.0 from NTTF

acadprog: Post Diploma B.Voc. B.Tech. Degree in a relevant field.
horizontalPathName: After completing 3 years of the full-time programme and gaining 3 years of industry experience, the job holder can work as an Electrical Supervisor, Maintenance Engineer, or Installation Engineer in industrial electrical systems, power generation, transmission, and distribution.
verticalPathName: With relevant experience, the job holder can progress to Senior Maintenance Engineer, Senior Installation Engineer, Project Engineer, or Electrical Manager.
